exposure: Sources of information influencing preferred delivery mode
sources of information about mode of delivery
cohort: 382 healthy nulliparous women aged 18-35, at >32 weeks of gestation with live, singleton pregnancies in Buenos Aires
finding: Higher socioeconomic status was associated with being less influenced by others and having better knowledge of indications for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Knowledge of cesarean indications was not associated with the source of information about mode of delivery preferences.
